input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for stack trace processor, abstract dao exception handler, problem access denied handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to use stack trace processor capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use abstract dao exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
